story:
Ethan ran toward the big, red couch and threw his favourite blue cape over his shoulders. [gesture:stretching] He was ready. Three chairs became his secret base, and the living room carpet was a dangerous river full of three-legged creatures.

Before Ethan could rescue his stuffed rabbit from the tall bookshelf, he reached up and knocked everything down. Books crashed loudly, the rabbit flew sideways, and Ethan froze because the mess looked impossible to fix alone. [emotion:QT/afraid] Then his older sister, Maya, walked in. She saw his worried face and crouched beside him. [emotion:QT/afraid] "What if we work together?" Maya suggested, picking up a chunky red book while Ethan gathered the smaller ones. [gesture:nodding-yes] "You think that will help?" Ethan asked, although he already felt less stuck. [emotion:QT/calm] [emotion:QT/happy] "Definitely," Maya said cheerfully. "After we finish this, we can build an even better base."

Finally, the shelf was tidy, the rabbit was rescued, and Ethan felt something warm and proud spreading through his chest. [emotion:QT/happy][gesture:emotions/hoora]

scenes: Ethan in the living room wearing a blue cape, leaping toward a big red couch with three chairs arranged as a secret base and the carpet imagined as a dangerous river.
Ethan frozen in front of a tall bookshelf surrounded by fallen books and a sideways stuffed rabbit, while his older sister Maya crouches beside him and they begin picking up books together.
The bookshelf neatly tidied with the stuffed rabbit rescued, and Ethan standing proudly with a warm smile on his face.

questions.question: What is the main message of this story about Ethan's rescue mission?
questions.correct_answer: Working together makes a hard problem easier to fix
wrong_answers: Making a mess means you are in trouble

questions.question: Before Ethan could rescue his stuffed rabbit, what three things crashed and fell down?
questions.correct_answer: Books fell off the tall bookshelf
wrong_answers: Three chairs fell into the river
The red couch and blue cape fell down

questions.question: After Maya walked in and saw Ethan's worried face, what did she suggest they do first?
questions.correct_answer: Work together to pick up the books
wrong_answers: Build a secret base with three chairs
Throw the rabbit back onto the shelf

questions.question: Why do you think Ethan already felt less stuck, although he had not finished cleaning up yet?
questions.correct_answer: Because Maya was there to help him, so he felt less afraid
wrong_answers: Because the three-legged creatures were chasing him away
Because he found a superhero power-up hidden in the books

questions.question: How do you think Ethan felt when the rabbit was finally rescued and the shelf was tidy again?
questions.correct_answer: Warm, proud, and happy that they finished the mission together
wrong_answers: Afraid that the bookshelf was going to crash again
Angry because Maya took charge of the whole rescue

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to let Maya help him?
questions.correct_answer: Asking for help makes hard things much easier to handle.
wrong_answers: Staying quiet and waiting is the best way to solve a big problem.
Fixing a mess by yourself shows everyone how strong you are.

questions.question: What did Ethan and Maya show us by what they did?
questions.correct_answer: Working together with someone you trust gets the job done faster.
wrong_answers: Splitting up and doing separate tasks is the quickest way to finish.
Watching someone else work helps you learn the best way to do things.

questions.question: What is one lesson from this story?
questions.correct_answer: Letting a friend or sibling join your plan can make it even more fun.
wrong_answers: Keeping your games and ideas to yourself makes them more special.
Playing alone means you get to choose every part of the adventure.

takeaways: Asking for help makes hard things much easier to handle.
Working together with someone you trust gets the job done faster.
Letting a friend or sibling join your plan can make it even more fun.
